findings.title: Removing the standalone wrapper validation newly admits inline composition_version=4
findings.requirement: Preserve denials and the accepted input language while removing only proven redundant validation; no implicit expansion of DATA/model projection support.
findings.mechanism: stage_payload calls validate(composition, entry, manifest), selecting method_execution=True from manifest composition_version=4. The removed public wrapper called validate(composition) without manifest/version, inferring version=3 for a records input. Those calls are not equivalent: v4 method predicates/base/role semantics pass the former and fail the latter. The policy function assumes prior validation and contains no equivalent v4 eligibility exclusion. Compact v4 remains denied because the policy requires inline text, but a fully stage-valid inline v4 composition is now accepted.
findings.reproducer: Use the real records source/compiler and BuildSource.build(method_execution=True), expand its exact compact record_pool with expanded_payload, reseal an inline composition and its single-entry manifest, and build the matching runtime binding. stage_payload accepts the exact graph. Run HEAD ModelProjections and working-tree ModelProjections against identical graphs/approvals with SQL and _verify_graph doubles; also run the unchanged public wrapper and a v3 positive control.
findings.impact: Concrete SOURCE accepted-language/no-write-on-denial regression. This is not evidence of a secret leak, native dispatch, live model authority or a PG write; those were not executed.
findings.minimal_remedy: Keep same-call reuse, but explicitly preserve supported projection eligibility before invoking projection_input, e.g. reject validated manifest composition_version=4 until separately authorized and specified. Add the inline-v4 denial regression beside a v3 positive; retain public-wrapper strictness, exact entry/pin checks and compact refusal. Do not reintroduce a cache, bypass flag or weaken stage validation.
findings.parent_action: Reproduce on the frozen snapshot, adjudicate, fix minimally with RED/GREEN and request focused re-review before PG acceptance.
